draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.38, the 28th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 3rd of 25 at LB. He went 27th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Willie Gay. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 111 tackles in 2021, 6th of 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers. 63 career games and 61 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (16 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: passer rating allowed 57.1 (100th percentile), approximate value 16 (98th percentile), passes defended 7 (94th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 off-ball linebacker who played: 81 combined tackles against a median of 40, above the norm.
